examples.text_en: This syndrome brings a high fever and a bad cough.
examples.text_zh: 这种综合征会带来高烧和严重的咳嗽。

examples.text_en: The doctor knew the syndrome from its first signs.
examples.text_zh: 医生从最初的症状就认出了这种综合征。

examples.text_en: The two groups have a synergic effect.
examples.text_zh: 这两个群体有协同作用。

examples.text_en: Their synergic effort made the plan succeed.
examples.text_zh: 他们协同的努力让计划成功了。

examples.text_en: Please write a short synopsis of the book.
examples.text_zh: 请给这本书写一个简短的概要。

examples.text_en: The synopsis explains the main story.
examples.text_zh: 摘要解释了主要故事。

examples.text_en: He gave a synoptic view of the report.
examples.text_zh: 他对报告做了一个概要性的说明。

examples.text_en: The synoptic chart shows the weather for today.
examples.text_zh: 这张天气图显示了今天的天气。

examples.text_en: Her book is a fine synthesis of two ideas.
examples.text_zh: 她的书是两种思想的绝佳综合。

examples.text_en: The process is a synthesis of art and science.
examples.text_zh: 这个过程是艺术与科学的综合体。

examples.text_en: The body can synthesize many things from simple food.
examples.text_zh: 身体能从简单的食物中合成许多物质。

examples.text_en: They tried to synthesize the two plans into one.
examples.text_zh: 他们试着把两个计划综合成一个。

examples.text_en: He took a systematic approach to the problem.
examples.text_zh: 他对问题采取了系统的方法。

examples.text_en: The work needs a systematic and careful method.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作需要系统而细致的方法。

examples.text_en: They made a systematical study of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这座小镇做了系统的研究。

examples.text_en: Her systematical notes helped the team.
examples.text_zh: 她系统的笔记帮助了团队。

examples.text_en: She systematically checked every page of the report.
examples.text_zh: 她系统地检查了报告的每一页。

examples.text_en: They worked systematically through the long list.
examples.text_zh: 他们有系统地处理这份长长的名单。

examples.text_en: They want to systematize the office work.
examples.text_zh: 他们想让办公室的工作系统化。

examples.text_en: He tried to systematize his notes and books.
examples.text_zh: 他试着把自己的笔记和书整理成系统。

examples.text_en: He wore a blue T-shirt to the game.
examples.text_zh: 他穿着一件蓝色圆领汗衫去看比赛。

examples.text_en: A soft white T-shirt is all she needs.
examples.text_zh: 一件柔软的白色圆领汗衫就是她需要的了。

examples.text_en: The doctor told him to take one tablet a day.
examples.text_zh: 医生叫他每天吃一片药。

examples.text_en: She drew on the small tablet with a pen.
examples.text_zh: 她用笔在小平板上画画。

examples.text_en: In that town the subject was a taboo.
examples.text_zh: 在那座小镇里，这个话题是个禁忌。

examples.text_en: They broke a taboo by talking about money.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈起钱，打破了一项禁忌。

examples.text_en: Please tabulate the results of the test.
examples.text_zh: 请把测试的结果列成表。

examples.text_en: They tabulate the numbers at the end of each week.
examples.text_zh: 他们在每周结束时把这些数字制成表格。

examples.text_en: There was a tacit agreement between the two.
examples.text_zh: 两人之间有一种缄默的默契。

examples.text_en: His tacit answer was simply to look away.
examples.text_zh: 他缄默的回答只是把目光移开。

examples.text_en: He pushed the tack into the soft wood.
examples.text_zh: 他把大头钉按进软木里。

examples.text_en: The tack on the wall held the picture.
examples.text_zh: 墙上的大头钉挂住了那幅画。

examples.text_en: The tackiness of the tape made it stick well.
examples.text_zh: 胶带的粘性使它贴得很牢。

examples.text_en: He felt the tackiness of the wet paint.
examples.text_zh: 他摸到了湿油漆的粘着感。

examples.text_en: She handled the matter with great tact.
examples.text_zh: 她极为老练地处理了这件事。

examples.text_en: It took tact to say no without a fight.
examples.text_zh: 要想不吵架地拒绝，需要些机智。

examples.text_en: They used a clever tactic to win the game.
examples.text_zh: 他们用了巧妙的战术赢下比赛。

examples.text_en: His favorite tactic was to wait and watch.
examples.text_zh: 他最喜欢的策略是等待和观察。

examples.text_en: The child learns about the world through tactile play.
examples.text_zh: 孩子通过触觉游戏认识世界。

examples.text_en: Her tactile sense was sharp even in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 即使在黑暗中，她的触觉也很敏锐。

examples.text_en: A small tadpole swam in the clear water.
examples.text_zh: 一只小蝌蚪在清水里游着。

examples.text_en: The children watched a tadpole turn into a frog.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们看着蝌蚪变成青蛙。

examples.text_en: There was a taint of fear in his voice.
examples.text_zh: 他的声音里带着一丝恐惧的阴影。

examples.text_en: The story left a taint on the family name.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事给家族的名声留下了污点。

examples.text_en: She wore a small talisman around her neck.
examples.text_zh: 她脖子上挂着一个小护身符。

examples.text_en: This talisman was said to bring good luck.
examples.text_zh: 据说这个护身符能带来好运。

examples.text_en: He kept a tally of every game we won.
examples.text_zh: 他记录着我们每场胜利的比分。

examples.text_en: The final tally showed a win for our team.
examples.text_zh: 最后的得分显示我们队赢了。

examples.text_en: The bird held the food in its sharp talon.
examples.text_zh: 那只鸟用锋利的爪子抓住食物。

examples.text_en: A great talon came down and took the fish.
examples.text_zh: 一只巨大的利爪扑下来抓走了鱼。

examples.text_en: The horse was tame and easy to ride.
examples.text_zh: 这匹马很温顺，容易骑。

examples.text_en: Their life in the small town was rather tame.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这座小镇的生活相当平淡。

examples.text_en: He used a tool to tamp the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 他用一件工具把湿地面夯实。

examples.text_en: They had to tamp the soil around the young tree.
examples.text_zh: 他们必须把幼树周围的土夯实。

examples.text_en: His long question was tangential to the main point.
examples.text_zh: 他那个冗长的问题偏离了要点。

examples.text_en: That remark was tangential and not really helpful.
examples.text_zh: 那句话离题了，其实没什么帮助。

examples.text_en: There was no tangible proof of the story.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事没有确实的证据。

examples.text_en: The new plan brought tangible help to the school.
examples.text_zh: 新计划给学校带来了实实在在的帮助。

examples.text_en: The long wires were in a hopeless tangle.
examples.text_zh: 长长的电线缠成了一团乱麻。

examples.text_en: He tried to free the tangle of wet ropes.
examples.text_zh: 他试着解开那团湿绳子的缠结。

examples.text_en: They danced a slow tango in the big hall.
examples.text_zh: 他们在大厅里跳了一支慢探戈。

examples.text_en: The tango music made everyone want to move.
examples.text_zh: 探戈音乐让每个人都想动起来。

examples.text_en: The sauce was tangy and full of strong flavor.
examples.text_zh: 这酱汁味道浓烈刺鼻。

examples.text_en: This tangy fruit has a strong and sharp taste.
examples.text_zh: 这种气味刺鼻的水果味道又浓又冲。

examples.text_en: The smell of food began to tantalize us.
examples.text_zh: 食物的香味开始馋得我们干着急。

examples.text_en: He would tantalize the dog with a small treat.
examples.text_zh: 他会用一小块零食逗弄那只狗。

examples.text_en: The little boy threw a tantrum in the shop.
examples.text_zh: 小男孩在店里大发脾气。

examples.text_en: She had a tantrum when she lost the game.
examples.text_zh: 她输了比赛就发起脾气来。

examples.text_en: He lit a small taper in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 他在暗房间里点了一支小蜡烛。

examples.text_en: The road began to taper toward the far end.
examples.text_zh: 道路向远处渐渐变窄。

examples.text_en: The tapering tower rose above the small town.
examples.text_zh: 那尖细的塔楼耸立在小镇上方。

examples.text_en: He drew a tapering line with his thin pen.
examples.text_zh: 他用细笔画了一条渐细的线。

examples.text_en: A fine tapestry hung on the stone wall.
examples.text_zh: 一幅精美的挂毯挂在石墙上。

examples.text_en: The tapestry showed a garden full of flowers.
examples.text_zh: 挂毯上是一座开满鲜花的花园。

examples.text_en: The doctor found a tapeworm in the sick child.
examples.text_zh: 医生在生病的孩子体内发现了一条绦虫。

examples.text_en: A tapeworm can live inside a person for years.
examples.text_zh: 绦虫能在人体内生活多年。

examples.text_en: The road was covered with thick black tar.
examples.text_zh: 路上覆盖着厚厚的黑色焦油。

examples.text_en: He used tar to keep the roof dry.
examples.text_zh: 他用柏油让屋顶保持干燥。

examples.text_en: His tardiness made the team wait again.
examples.text_zh: 他的迟到又让团队等了一次。

examples.text_en: The teacher did not like tardiness in class.
examples.text_zh: 老师不喜欢上课迟到。

examples.text_en: He was tardy for the meeting two days in a row.
examples.text_zh: 他连续两天开会迟到。

examples.text_en: The tardy student ran into the empty room.
examples.text_zh: 这个迟到的学生跑进空荡荡的教室。

examples.text_en: The tare of the box was written on it.
examples.text_zh: 箱子的皮重写在上面。

examples.text_en: They weighed the tare before adding the goods.
examples.text_zh: 他们在装货前称了皮重。

examples.text_en: The new tariff raised the price of foreign goods.
examples.text_zh: 新关税提高了外国商品的价格。

examples.text_en: They talked about the tariff on imported food.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了进口食品的关税。

examples.text_en: Wet air can tarnish the silver spoon.
examples.text_zh: 潮湿的空气会让银勺失去光泽。

examples.text_en: One bad act may tarnish a fine name.
examples.text_zh: 一次坏行为可能玷污一个好名声。

examples.text_en: They put a tarpaulin over the wet wood.
examples.text_zh: 他们给湿木头盖上油布。

examples.text_en: A large tarpaulin kept the rain off the goods.
examples.text_zh: 一大块柏油帆布替货物挡住了雨。

examples.text_en: Do not tarry here or we will be late.
examples.text_zh: 别在这里耽搁，不然我们要迟到了。

examples.text_en: They did not tarry long at the small inn.
examples.text_zh: 他们没有在小客栈久留。

examples.text_en: The soup was tasteless and needed some salt.
examples.text_zh: 这汤没味道，需要加点盐。

examples.text_en: He told a tasteless joke at the party.
examples.text_zh: 他在聚会上讲了个低俗的笑话。

examples.text_en: He wore a tattered coat in the cold wind.
examples.text_zh: 他在寒风中穿着一件破烂的外套。

examples.text_en: The tattered book fell apart in my hands.
examples.text_zh: 那本破旧的书在我手里散开了。

examples.text_en: The tatty chair was ready for the fire.
examples.text_zh: 这把破旧的椅子已经可以当柴烧了。

examples.text_en: She wore a tatty hat that looked quite worn.
examples.text_zh: 她戴着一顶看起来很旧的帽子。

examples.text_en: The rope was taut and ready for the pull.
examples.text_zh: 绳子拉得紧紧的，准备用力了。

examples.text_en: Her face was taut with worry and lack of sleep.
examples.text_zh: 她的脸因忧虑和缺觉而紧绷。

examples.text_en: He had to tauten the rope before the climb.
examples.text_zh: 攀登前他必须把绳子绷紧。

examples.text_en: The wind began to tauten the sail above them.
examples.text_zh: 风开始把他们上方的帆绷紧。

examples.text_en: His tautological words said the same thing twice.
examples.text_zh: 他重复的话语把同一件事说了两遍。

examples.text_en: The sentence was tautological and easy to shorten.
examples.text_zh: 这个句子是赘述的，很容易缩短。

examples.text_en: They drank and sang in the tavern.
examples.text_zh: 他们在酒馆里喝酒唱歌。

examples.text_en: The tavern stood at the end of the street.
examples.text_zh: 酒馆立在街道的尽头。

examples.text_en: She wore a tawdry dress of bright cheap cloth.
examples.text_zh: 她穿着一件廉价俗丽的亮色裙子。

examples.text_en: The show was tawdry but somehow rather fun.
examples.text_zh: 这场演出廉价俗气，却不知怎的挺有趣。

examples.text_en: The new taxation hit small business very hard.
examples.text_zh: 新税制对小企业打击很大。

examples.text_en: They talked about taxation at the long meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他们在漫长的会议上讨论了征税。

examples.text_en: The long walk was taxing for the man.
examples.text_zh: 这段长路对这个人来说很费力。

examples.text_en: Her work is taxing but she loves it.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作很繁重，但她喜欢。

examples.text_en: The taxonomist named a new kind of small plant.
examples.text_zh: 这位分类学家为一种新的小植物命名。

examples.text_en: A good taxonomist can sort many living things.
examples.text_zh: 好的分类学家能对许多生物进行分类。

examples.text_en: The paper was too technical for most readers.
examples.text_zh: 这篇论文对大多数读者来说太专业了。

examples.text_en: He gave me a technical explanation of the machine.
examples.text_zh: 他给我做了一番关于这台机器的技术性解释。

examples.text_en: She learned new techniques for painting in water.
examples.text_zh: 她学会了在水彩画中使用的新技巧。

examples.text_en: These techniques are simple and easy to learn.
examples.text_zh: 这些方法简单易学。

examples.text_en: The new technocrat wanted to change the system.
examples.text_zh: 这位新的技术专家治国论者想改变体制。

examples.text_en: A technocrat trusts facts and careful planning.
examples.text_zh: 技术专家治国论者相信事实和周密的计划。

examples.text_en: They study tectonics to understand the moving earth.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究构造学，以理解运动的地球。

examples.text_en: Tectonics explains how mountains and deep valleys form.
examples.text_zh: 构造学解释了山脉和深谷是如何形成的。

examples.text_en: The long meeting was tedious and rather useless.
examples.text_zh: 冗长的会议沉闷又没什么用。

examples.text_en: He found the book tedious and put it down.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得这本书冗长乏味，就放下了。

examples.text_en: The tedium of the long day made him sleepy.
examples.text_zh: 漫长一天的单调乏味让他昏昏欲睡。

examples.text_en: She sang to break the tedium of the work.
examples.text_zh: 她唱歌来打破工作的沉闷。

examples.text_en: The man began to teeter on the high wall.
examples.text_zh: 那人开始在墙头上摇摇晃晃。

examples.text_en: The plan seemed to teeter on the edge.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划似乎在边缘摇摇欲坠。

examples.text_en: He has been teetotal for many years now.
examples.text_zh: 他多年来一直滴酒不沾。

examples.text_en: Their teetotal group never drinks at any party.
examples.text_zh: 他们这个绝对戒酒的小组在任何聚会上都不喝酒。

examples.text_en: The telecommuter works from home three days a week.
examples.text_zh: 这位远程工作者每周有三天在家工作。

examples.text_en: As a telecommuter, she rarely goes to the office.
examples.text_zh: 作为远程工作者，她很少去办公室。

examples.text_en: The office used a telex to send the news.
examples.text_zh: 办公室用电传打字机发送消息。

examples.text_en: A telex machine stood in the corner.
examples.text_zh: 角落里立着一台电传机。

examples.text_en: He had the temerity to question the chief.
examples.text_zh: 他竟鲁莽地质疑起首领。

examples.text_en: She spoke with temerity and soon felt sorry.
examples.text_zh: 她鲁莽地开了口，很快就后悔了。

examples.text_en: The office hired a temp for the busy week.
examples.text_zh: 办公室为这个忙碌的一周雇了一名临时雇员。

examples.text_en: She worked as a temp in a large bank.
examples.text_zh: 她在一家大银行做临时雇员。

examples.text_en: The horse has a calm and gentle temperament.
examples.text_zh: 这匹马性情平和温顺。

examples.text_en: Their different temperaments often led to talks.
examples.text_zh: 他们不同的性情常常引出长谈。

examples.text_en: The car was temperamental in cold weather.
examples.text_zh: 这辆车天一冷就闹脾气。

examples.text_en: He was a temperamental artist with strong feelings.
examples.text_zh: 他是个情绪化的艺术家，感受强烈。

examples.text_en: They spoke about temperance at the town meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他们在镇上会议上谈到了戒酒。

examples.text_en: His temperance gave the family a quiet peace.
examples.text_zh: 他的节制给家里带来了安宁。

examples.text_en: It was a tempestuous night of wind and rain.
examples.text_zh: 那是个风雨交加的暴乱之夜。

examples.text_en: Their tempestuous talk ended in a cold silence.
examples.text_zh: 他们激烈的谈话以冷场告终。

examples.text_en: The song began at a slow and gentle tempo.
examples.text_zh: 这首歌以缓慢柔和的节奏开始。

examples.text_en: They changed the tempo of the game.
examples.text_zh: 他们改变了比赛的节奏。

examples.text_en: The story deals with temporal power and its cost.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事讲的是世俗权力及其代价。

examples.text_en: His interests were temporal and not at all spiritual.
examples.text_zh: 他的兴趣都在世俗之事上，与精神无关。

examples.text_en: The road was temporarily closed for the race.
examples.text_zh: 这条路因比赛暂时封闭。

examples.text_en: She stayed temporarily with her friends.
examples.text_zh: 她暂时住在朋友家里。

examples.text_en: He tried to temporize and avoid a clear answer.
examples.text_zh: 他试图拖延，回避明确的答复。

examples.text_en: They would temporize rather than fight that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天他们宁愿拖延也不愿开战。

examples.text_en: The idea was no longer tenable after that.
examples.text_zh: 在那之后，这个观点再也站不住脚了。

examples.text_en: Her position on the issue was clear and tenable.
examples.text_zh: 她在这个问题上的立场明确而站得住脚。

examples.text_en: He was tenacious and would not give up.
examples.text_zh: 他很执着，不肯放弃。

examples.text_en: The tenacious little plant grew through the stone.
examples.text_zh: 这株顽强的小植物从石头缝里长了出来。

examples.text_en: Their tenancy of the house lasts two years.
examples.text_zh: 他们租住这所房子的期限是两年。

examples.text_en: He signed a tenancy for the farm.
examples.text_zh: 他为农场签了租约。

examples.text_en: The report was tendentious and left out facts.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告有偏向，漏掉了事实。

examples.text_en: His tendentious talk upset the other group.
examples.text_zh: 他有倾向性的讲话惹恼了对方群体。

examples.text_en: The doctor felt the tendinous part of his arm.
examples.text_zh: 医生摸到了他手臂上腱的部分。

examples.text_en: A tendinous band lay under the thin skin.
examples.text_zh: 一条腱带位于薄薄的皮肤之下。

examples.text_en: The poor family lived in a dark tenement.
examples.text_zh: 这户穷人家住在一栋阴暗的公寓里。

examples.text_en: The tenement had many small rooms and no heat.
examples.text_zh: 这栋公寓小房间很多，却没有暖气。

examples.text_en: Fair play is a central tenet of the game.
examples.text_zh: 公平竞赛是这项运动的核心信条。

examples.text_en: They held to the tenets of their group.
examples.text_zh: 他们坚守着群体的宗旨。

examples.text_en: The tensile strength of the rope was very high.
examples.text_zh: 这根绳子的抗拉强度非常高。

examples.text_en: They tested the tensile power of the thin wire.
examples.text_zh: 他们测试了细金属丝的拉力。

examples.text_en: The tension in the room was easy to feel.
examples.text_zh: 房间里的紧张气氛很容易感觉到。

examples.text_en: They worked to reduce the tension between the groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们努力缓和两个群体之间的紧张关系。

examples.text_en: A long tentacle came out of the dark water.
examples.text_zh: 一条长长的触手从黑暗的水里伸出来。

examples.text_en: Each tentacle of the animal moved on its own.
examples.text_zh: 这动物的每根触须都各自活动。

examples.text_en: They made a tentative plan for the trip.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这次行程订了一个试验性的计划。

examples.text_en: Her first steps were tentative and slow.
examples.text_zh: 她最初的几步试探而缓慢。

examples.text_en: Their tenuous friendship did not last very long.
examples.text_zh: 他们脆弱的友谊没有维持多久。

examples.text_en: The link between the two events was tenuous.
examples.text_zh: 这两件事之间的联系很微弱。

examples.text_en: He has tenure at the city college.
examples.text_zh: 他在城市学院拥有终身职位。

examples.text_en: During her tenure the school grew a great deal.
examples.text_zh: 在她任职期间，学校发展了很多。

examples.text_en: The tea was tepid and not at all nice.
examples.text_zh: 茶已经不冷不热，一点也不好吃。

examples.text_en: They gave the plan only a tepid welcome.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这个计划只是不冷不热地表示欢迎。

examples.text_en: The termination of the contract surprised everyone.
examples.text_zh: 合同的终止让所有人都很意外。

examples.text_en: He asked about the termination of his work.
examples.text_zh: 他询问了自己工作的终止事宜。

examples.text_en: The train reached its terminus late at night.
examples.text_zh: 火车在深夜到达了终点站。

examples.text_en: The bus stopped at the final terminus.
examples.text_zh: 那辆巴士在终点站停了下来。

examples.text_en: A small termite can eat through hard wood.
examples.text_zh: 小小的白蚁能蛀穿坚硬的木头。

examples.text_en: They found termite damage in the floor.
examples.text_zh: 他们在地板里发现了白蚁造成的损坏。

examples.text_en: They sat on the terrace and watched the sun.
examples.text_zh: 他们坐在露台上看太阳。

examples.text_en: The rice grew on a wide terrace near the hill.
examples.text_zh: 水稻长在山边一片宽阔的梯田上。

examples.text_en: The story was about terrestrial life and its future.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事讲的是地球上的生命及其未来。

examples.text_en: He studied both terrestrial and sea animals.
examples.text_zh: 他同时研究陆地动物和海洋动物。

examples.text_en: The two countries had a long territorial dispute.
examples.text_zh: 两国之间长期存在领土争端。

examples.text_en: The animals fought over their territorial space.
examples.text_zh: 这些动物为各自的领地打架。

examples.text_en: His terse answer told us nothing at all.
examples.text_zh: 他简短的回答什么也没告诉我们。

examples.text_en: She wrote a terse note and left the room.
examples.text_zh: 她写了一张简短的字条就离开了房间。

examples.text_en: Tertiary education is important for a good career.
examples.text_zh: 高等教育对好的职业很重要。

examples.text_en: The tertiary stage of the work begins next week.
examples.text_zh: 工作的第三阶段下周开始。

examples.text_en: The testator left the house to his son.
examples.text_zh: 立遗嘱者把房子留给了儿子。

examples.text_en: Every testator must sign the paper in front of witnesses.
examples.text_zh: 每位立遗嘱者都必须在证人面前签署文件。
